title: Gulf Island Rentals
specs: Located on Okaloosa Island near Crab Island with quick access to popular attractions
Jet skis are premium Yamaha WaveRunners with speeds up to 48 mph
Common to see wild dolphins in the area though sightings not guaranteed
Guided Dolphin Tours: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Valid photo ID for every driver
If born on or after Jan 1, 1988, must have Florida Boater’s Safety Card or Nationally Recognized Boater’s Safety Card
Operators must receive training procedures and follow safety rules
Driver must speak English for dolphin tour
Jet skis accommodate up to 3 riders or 530 pounds
Can accommodate groups with multiple jet skis; group and party packages customizable

services.name: Jetski Rentals
services.desc: Flexible 1-, 2-, 3-, 4- or 8-hour jet ski rentals on the Emerald Coast from Gulf Island Jetski Rentals in Fort Walton Beach.

services.name: Guided Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Two-hour guided dolphin-watching tour on Yamaha WaveRunners across Choctawhatchee Bay and nearby bayous led by local guides.

includes: Guided natural-history commentary on dolphin tour
blurb: Guests rent Yamaha WaveRunners to explore Destin's Emerald Coast waterways. Rentals are self-guided within designated riding zones. A guided two-hour dolphin tour is also offered with a local guide leading through Choctawhatchee Bay, Cinco Bayou, and Poquito Bayou.
extraNote: Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · Please cancel 24 hours prior to the WaveRunner rental start time for a full refund. · If the rental is cut short due to inclement weather or WaveRunner issues we will issue a raincheck that can be used for a different rental date and time. · If the trip is canceled by Gulf Island Rentals you will be issued a full refund. · Once you leave the docks there are no refunds or rain checks so please make sure the weather will be good for the duration of your trip. · Cancel 24 hours prior for full refund · Refunds only if equipment not used; unused time due to weather can be used another day · No refunds or rain checks once you leave the docks · Minor
